results.name: AdjoinRoot
results.source_text:
/-- Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`. -/
def AdjoinRoot [CommRing R] (f : R[X]) : Type _ :=
  Polynomial R ⧸ (span {f} : Ideal R[X])
results.docstring:
Adjoin a root of a polynomial `f` to a commutative ring `R`. We define the new ring
as the quotient of `R[X]` by the principal ideal generated by `f`.

@[simp]
theorem aeval_root_eq_map : aeval h.root = h.map := by ext; simp

results.name: AdjoinRoot.aeval_algHom_eq_zero
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem aeval_algHom_eq_zero (ϕ : AdjoinRoot f →ₐ[R] S) : aeval (ϕ (root f)) f = 0 := by
  have h : ϕ.toRingHom.comp (of f) = algebraMap R S := RingHom.ext_iff.mpr ϕ.commutes
  rw [aeval_def, ← h, ← map_zero ϕ.toRingHom, ← eval₂_root f, hom_eval₂]
  rfl

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
